verses.en: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
verses.pt: Aos anciãos, pois, que há entre vós, rogo eu, que sou ancião com eles e testemunha dos sofrimentos de Cristo, e participante da glória que se há de revelar:
verses.en_web: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed.
verses.en_bbe: I who am myself one of the rulers of the church, and a witness of the death of Christ, having my part in the coming glory, send this serious request to the chief men among you:

verses.en: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
verses.pt: Apascentai o rebanho de Deus, que está entre vós, não por força, mas espontaneamente segundo a vontade de Deus; nem por torpe ganância, mas de boa vontade;
verses.en_web: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
verses.en_bbe: Keep watch over the flock of God which is in your care, using your authority, not as forced to do so, but gladly; and not for unclean profit but with a ready mind;

verses.en: Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
verses.pt: nem como dominadores sobre os que vos foram confiados, mas servindo de exemplo ao rebanho.
verses.en_web: neither as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
verses.en_bbe: Not as lords over God's heritage, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

verses.en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verses.pt: E, quando se manifestar o sumo Pastor, recebereis a imarcescível coroa da glória.
verses.en_web: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
verses.en_bbe: And at the coming of the chief Keeper of the sheep, you will be given the eternal crown of glory.

verses.en: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
verses.pt: Semelhantemente vós, os mais moços, sede sujeitos aos mais velhos. E cingi-vos todos de humildade uns para com os outros, porque Deus resiste aos soberbos, mas dá graça aos humildes.
verses.en_web: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
verses.en_bbe: And in the same way, let the younger men be ruled by the older ones. Let all of you put away pride and make yourselves ready to be servants: for God is a hater of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low.

verses.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
verses.pt: Humilhai-vos, pois, debaixo da potente mão de Deus, para que a seu tempo vos exalte;
verses.en_web: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;
verses.en_bbe: For this cause make yourselves low under the strong hand of God, so that when the time comes you may be lifted up;

verses.en: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.pt: lançando sobre ele toda a vossa ansiedade, porque ele tem cuidado de vós.
verses.en_web: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
verses.en_bbe: Putting all your troubles on him, for he takes care of you.

verses.en: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.pt: Sede sóbrios, vigiai. O vosso adversário, o Diabo, anda em derredor, rugindo como leão, e procurando a quem possa tragar;
verses.en_web: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
verses.en_bbe: Be serious and keep watch; the Evil One, who is against you, goes about like a lion with open mouth in search of food;

verses.en: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
verses.pt: ao qual resisti firmes na fé, sabendo que os mesmos sofrimentos estão-se cumprindo entre os vossos irmãos no mundo.
verses.en_web: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give way to him but be strong in your faith, in the knowledge that your brothers who are in the world undergo the same troubles.

verses.en: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
verses.pt: E o Deus de toda a graça, que em Cristo vos chamou à sua eterna glória, depois de haverdes sofrido por um pouco, ele mesmo vos há de aperfeiçoar, confirmar e fortalecer.
verses.en_web: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
verses.en_bbe: And after you have undergone pain for a little time, the God of all grace who has given you a part in his eternal glory through Christ Jesus, will himself give you strength and support, and make you complete in every good thing;

verses.en: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.pt: A ele seja o domínio para todo o sempre. Amém.
verses.en_web: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: His is the power for ever. So be it.

verses.en: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
verses.pt: Por Silvano, nosso fiel irmão, como o considero, escravo abreviadamente, exortando e testificando que esta é a verdadeira graça de Deus; nela permanecei firmes.
verses.en_web: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
verses.en_bbe: I have sent you this short letter by Silvanus, a true brother, in my opinion; comforting you and witnessing that this is the true grace of God; keep to it.

verses.en: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
verses.pt: A vossa co-eleita em Babilônia vos saúda, como também meu filho Marcos.
verses.en_web: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you; and so does Mark, my son.
verses.en_bbe: She who is in Babylon, who has a part with you in the purpose of God, sends you her love; and so does my son Mark.

verses.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.pt: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com ósculo de amor. Paz seja com todos vós que estais em Cristo.
verses.en_web: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Give one another the kiss of love. Peace be to you all in Christ.
